description: This file defines the class JsonMissingFieldException, an exception thrown when a required JSON field is missing. It includes constructors for creating exceptions based on a JSON key or field definition, and provides a builder class for customizable exception creation.

classes.name: JsonMissingFieldException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a required JSON field was missing.
